DESTROY.INDEX_BASIS: positions in each start's normalized (sorted) portfolio
DESTROY.SELECTION: random.Random(seed).sample(all C(20,3) index triples, 24), sampled order

EXACT_CANDIDATES_SCORED_DEFINITION: repaired K20 portfolios (in-pool 3-subsets) scored with an exact integer count
NOT_CLAIMED: no gain in complete N3 when the pool has none
PEAK_RSS_DEFINITION: max per-process peak RSS over the main process and workers

POOL_POLICY.MANDATORY: removed incumbent tickets + distinct elite tickets not in R
POOL_POLICY.RANKING: exact residual marginal |B(t)| vs R descending, then lowest ticket
POOL_POLICY.TWO_NUMBER_REPLACEMENTS: BOUNDED_GUIDED_SUBSET: one-number replacements of each removed ticket's top 4 one-number replacements by exact residual marginal; the full 15*903 two-number family per ticket is not generated
